findings.label: Hardcoded JWT secret with environment fallback
findings.description: The auth.py module defines JWT_SECRET with a hardcoded default value that runs if the environment variable is not set. This creates a risk of accidentally using a shared secret in production. Require the environment variable at startup and fail fast if missing.

findings.label: Message endpoint asymmetric authorization
findings.description: The POST /api/messages endpoint accepts either JWT or token auth but does not require the buyer to specify which supplier the message is directed to. Buyer messages are assigned supplier_id from message_data.supplier_id or current_user['user_id'], which may result in messages being visible to unintended parties or creating ambiguity about which supplier thread they belong to.
